name: Scriba—suas ideias em Markdown
subtitle: Notas, desenhos e GitHub
promotionalText: Escreva em Markdown, organize suas notas e transforme ideias em diagramas. Trabalhe offline e escolha onde guardar seus arquivos.
description:
Scriba é um editor Markdown para escrever, ler e organizar suas ideias. Comece sem criar uma conta e mantenha suas notas no dispositivo.

ESCREVA E LEIA
Edite diretamente no texto formatado ou abra o código Markdown. Use títulos, listas, tarefas, tabelas, links e imagens. Navegue pelo índice de títulos e confira palavras, caracteres e seleção.

ORGANIZE
Busque nas notas recentes, fixe as mais importantes e acompanhe as alterações. Os guias incluídos apresentam exemplos editáveis para começar.

DESENHE
Visualize diagramas Mermaid e ZenUML, compare motores compatíveis e crie desenhos com Excalidraw. Amplie, inspecione o código e exporte SVG ou PNG transparente.

ESCOLHA O DESTINO
Trabalhe offline, selecione uma pasta em Arquivos ou conecte opcionalmente seu GitHub. Importe Markdown e pacotes ZIP; compartilhe notas e imagens pelo menu do sistema. A sincronização GitHub ocorre enquanto o aplicativo está aberto e conectado.

SEUS ARQUIVOS
Notas privadas ficam no aplicativo até você escolher um destino. Exporte backups antes de remover o aplicativo. Um repositório GitHub público torna públicos os arquivos sincronizados.

reviewNotes:
Review recording: Scriba-1.16.1-review-physical-iPhone.mp4, attached to our App Review correspondence.

Hello App Review Team,

Thank you for your message under Guideline 2.1. We have updated the submission to Scriba 1.16.1 (27) and corrected the localized privacy policy URLs and required listing metadata.

1. Physical-device demonstration
The attached owner-provided recording demonstrates Scriba on a physical iPhone 17 Pro Max running iOS 26.3. It begins on the Home Screen immediately before opening Scriba and shows the normal workflow: reference notes, diagrams, creating and editing a note, whiteboard shapes and colors, returning to the note, and appearance settings. The recording was supplied for this release. Only the introductory Settings screen showing device identifiers was removed; the subsequent workflow remains continuous.

2. Purpose and audience
Scriba is a general-purpose Markdown editor for the public, including students, writers, researchers and professionals. It is not restricted to employees or a particular organization.

3. Access and features
No Scriba account, registration, subscription or purchase is required. Launch the app and open the bundled reference notes, or create a note. Core editing and diagram libraries are bundled for offline use. Settings offers a native Files folder picker; import and export use native system interfaces. Optional GitHub connects the user’s own repository through official authorization. It is a repository integration, not a Scriba identity account. The core editor requires no credentials.

4. External services
Bundled components include Capacitor, CodeMirror, TipTap, Mermaid, Beautiful Mermaid, Pele, ZenUML and Excalidraw. Optional GitHub synchronization uses GitHub and our HTTPS gateway, with Cloudflare network infrastructure. Files access uses Apple’s picker and the user-selected storage provider. There are no ads, purchases, AI services or remote executable code updates.

5. Regional availability
Core features and included content are consistent across regions. Optional GitHub and Files providers depend on their availability and the user’s permissions. There are no region-specific paid features.

6. Content and business model
Users create and manage their own private documents and drawings. There is no public feed, messaging service or third-party media catalog. Scriba does not provide regulated financial, medical or other professional services.

The same information is included in App Review Information. Thank you for reviewing the updated build.
